claim: Luxshare's 30-hectare Bac Giang, Vietnam factory (Van Trung Industrial Park) was physically constructed in 5 months after Apple requested the capacity expansion -- the single fastest quantified shell-construction lead time found for Vietnam manufacturing.
stance_target: the brief's assumption that manufacturing diversification is physically slow, specifically as regards SHELL CONSTRUCTION (not full production ramp)
scope_conditions: physical factory shell construction only, one Luxshare facility, 2020
quoted_support: According to Bang, the 30-hectare factory was constructed in 5 months after Apple's request to expand production. "Apple Corporation is impressed by the speed at which our fast facility is built here."

claim: Despite the fast physical build, Apple explicitly withheld approval for iPhone production at the Luxshare Bac Giang facility in 2020 because on-site worker dormitory conditions did not meet Apple's supplier-conduct standards -- the binding constraint was regulatory/labor-compliance, not construction speed or physical capacity.
stance_target: the assumption that manufacturing diversification lead time is purely a physical/capex constraint
scope_conditions: one facility, 2020, specific to iPhone assembly approval
quoted_support: part of the facility has yet to meet Apple's requirements, specifically those relating to the on-side dormitories. It is unclear what requirements Luxshare missed, but it seems to be the main thing holding back the facility from gaining Apple's approval.

claim: AUDITED ABSENCE: as of the current research date (Sept 2026), six years after Apple's 2020 inspection of a Vietnam facility for potential iPhone assembly, iPhone final assembly still has not moved to Vietnam -- only AirPods, iPad, Apple Watch and some MacBook models have. India remains the sole non-China iPhone final-assembly location. No source found (searched TechCrunch, AppleInsider, Nikkei Asia via secondary citation, vietnam-briefing.com, SCMP, SAG Wearables/Smartphone trackers) reports Vietnam iPhone final assembly at any point 2020-2026.
stance_target: manufacturing diversification is a simple physical/capex-timeline function that would have produced Vietnam iPhone assembly by now if capex/lead-time were the only constraint
scope_conditions: iPhone final assembly specifically, Vietnam, 2020-2026; audited absence, not a confirmed negative from an official Apple statement
quoted_support: Apple is considering the possibility of bringing iPhone manufacturing to Vietnam, a report claims, after the Cupertino company visited a factory owned by assembly partner Luxshare to check the conditions of the facility. [2020 article -- no subsequent iPhone-in-Vietnam assembly confirmed as of 2026 across all sources checked]
numbers: 0% iPhone final assembly share in Vietnam, 2020-2026 (audited absence)
